Title: Ireland – School furniture – PRE-QUALIFICATION QUESTIONNAIRE (PQQ) for Design, Build, Manufacture and Installation of Adaptable Educational Workstation Frames for TU Dublin
Procedure title: PRE-QUALIFICATION QUESTIONNAIRE (PQQ) for Design, Build, Manufacture and Installation of Adaptable Educational Workstation Frames for TU Dublin
Description: For the purposes of this PQQ, the requirement is for the supply and installation of up to 64 Adaptable Educational Workstation Frames, comprising 32 units for North House Building and 32 units for Premier House Building. The final configuration will vary depending on the final floor layouts. It is anticipated that the Plaza layout will consist of four rows of eight workstations, with the two external rows requiring rear sliding-door access and the two central rows configured back-to-back without rear access doors. The design may also need to accommodate existing structural features, including pillars, within North House Building. At present, no equivalent configuration or floor layout has been developed for Premier House Building. The successful tenderer(s) will be required to work collaboratively with the project design team during the dialogue phase to establish the most appropriate Adaptable Educational Workstation Frame configuration and layout for Premier House Building, taking account of operational requirements and any site-specific constraints.
